crossRefs.note: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first…
Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom…
These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was…

parallels.note: When David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the army of the mighty men.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.
translations.bsb: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
translations.kjv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
translations.asv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
